create_tensordict_from_dict: create a TensorDict from a nested dictionary of PyTorch tensors using from_tree
flatten_tensordict: flatten a TensorDict into a list of key tuples and leaf tensors using flatten
map_function_over_tensordict: apply a transformation function to all leaf tensors in a TensorDict using map
index_tensordict_with_slice: index a TensorDict with a tensor slice to get a new TensorDict of sliced leaves
transpose_list_of_dicts: transpose a list of dictionaries into a dictionary of lists using transpose_list_of_dicts
